Birch Dutch Auction Inc is offering to purchase for cash shares of its common stock at a price not greater than $23.00 nor less than $20.00 per share, net to the seller in cash, less any applicable withholding taxes and without interest. The Offer will expire at 12:00 midnight, New York City time, on December 2, 2026. Priority of Purchases: shares properly tendered by odd lot holders will be purchased first, with odd lots receiving priority and not subject to proration.
